goal: Select a live Provider at provider/model granularity before fresh product convergence and scale validation.
acceptance_criteria: all configured provider/model candidates are checked before global blocking
a failed primary model does not hide an available backup model
fresh validation entrypoints do not hardcode one model
the existing production split-file leaf executor remains the only ProviderJob execution path
frozen project-generation benchmark hashes remain unchanged

quality_metrics.measure: focused auto-select, convergence, ACFV, commercial, guard, and contract regression
quality_metrics.method: live capability preflight, pytest, guards, py_compile, and frozen hashes

prevention: Keep model selection outside ProviderJob scheduling and delivery authority.
assurance: Probe structured output and record context/output suitability for every candidate.
control: Block fresh generation only when no configured candidate is eligible.
improvement: Run fresh CASE01/CASE03 only after the committed preflight checkpoint passes.

interface_expectations: CLI model overrides remain optional operator constraints.
Omitted model arguments consume provider_resilience auto-selection.
No generated candidate is manually modified.

feedback: Focused production regression passed with 192 passed and 24 skipped; frozen benchmark hashes were unchanged.

worked: Provider/model candidates are evaluated independently and fresh validation consumes one selected model without adding a scheduler.
did_not_work: A single qwen3.8-flash HTTP 403 previously stopped the whole validation attempt.
experiments: Probe every compatible configured model and select the strongest eligible role.
